snippet.title: Tattie Bogle - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You are the scarecrow.

On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you
off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn
the place around before it all falls apart?

A challenging fairytale roguelite. Solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015050
Website: https://www.pinefog.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/NT3hs9Xvrn
X: https://x.com/mrsetheen

PineFog Studios
